home.h1: Custom compact and folding umbrellas, built to your specification.
home.intro: OEM and ODM supply of handheld rain umbrellas for distributors, retail brands and promotional programmes. A small selection of beach umbrellas is available alongside the core range. We handle artwork, sampling, production, inspection and export documentation in one supply chain — starting with a written quotation, not a checkout.
home.note: MOQ, lead times and inspection standards are indicative and are confirmed in writing with your quotation and specification sheet.
home.supplyTitle: One supply chain, from artwork to shipment
home.supplyBody: We started in digital printing and grew into full custom manufacturing. That means print, construction and finishing are managed together rather than handed between suppliers.

capabilities.title: Digital printing
capabilities.text: All-over custom print, Pantone matching and a digital layout for approval before any strike-off is produced.

capabilities.title: Sampling & tooling
capabilities.text: Printed strike-off or full prototype, with changes confirmed in writing before bulk production starts.

capabilities.title: Quality control
capabilities.text: In-line checks and pre-shipment inspection against an agreed specification sheet, with third-party audits on request.

home.programmesTitle: Built for programmes, not one-off orders
home.programmesBody: Everything below is agreed in writing before production, so repeat orders stay consistent.

programmes.title: OEM & ODM
programmes.text: Your design and specification, or ours adapted to your market.

programmes.title: Private label
programmes.text: Custom labels, packaging and retail-ready presentation.

programmes.title: Export-ready
programmes.text: EXW, FOB and CIF terms, packing data and shipment documents.

home.rangeBody: Our core range is handheld rain umbrellas — three-fold, five-fold, straight, golf and kids styles. A few beach umbrellas are available for resort and promotional programmes. Every item can be adapted in size, frame, fabric and print.
home.ctaBody: Share a design, a quantity and your market — we reply with a written quotation and the next steps.
